worker_claim.report: Updated launcher and worker sanitation logic, adjusted launcher regression coverage, added related packaging metadata coverage, and hardened standalone systemd proof validation. Focused launcher, worker, and systemd tests pass; full-suite execution exceeded the available command timeout.
worker_claim.summary: Standalone launcher detection now treats validated PEX/SCIE metadata as the durable outer executable identity without relying on sys.argv[0]. Worker subprocess environments strip inherited PEX/SCIE packaging metadata, and the standalone distribution proof now asserts that rendered systemd ExecStart uses the exact outer artifact.
